title: Hall Validity
text: Compute rotor spin direction and validity of Hall sensor sequence, 4 inputs, 5 outputs, {Counter size} sets Size of external counter register 16; {Expected hall sequence in positive direction} sets the sequence indicating positive and {Sequence} sets the custom sequence indicating positive direction. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: HallVal
ports.summary: Current Hall sensor output state scalar

ports.name: PrevHallVal
ports.summary: Previous Hall sensor output state scalar

ports.name: PrevDir
ports.summary: Rotor spin direction during previous Hall state scalar

ports.name: Invalid
ports.summary: Indicator of Hall state validity scalar

ports.name: SpdCnt
ports.summary: Count at Hall state change scalar

ports.name: Dir
ports.summary: Rotor spin direction during current Hall state scalar

ports.name: SpdVal
ports.summary: Validity of current and previous Hall states and speed calculation scalar

ports.name: HallChng
ports.summary: Set flag to one, indicating Hall state change scalar

params.name: Expected hall sequence in positive direction
params.values: Sequence indicating positive direction ABC (default) | CBA | Custom sequence

params.name: Sequence
params.values: Custom sequence indicating positive direction [5,4,6,2,3,1] (default) | scalar

params.name: Counter size
params.values: Size of external counter register 16 bits (default) | 8 bits | 32 bits
